intro.en: Purpose beyond para que: formal connectors, a que after verbs of movement, and no sea que.

a que.en: so that (after a verb of movement)

texto.en:
With **one subject**, purpose is a preposition + **infinitive**: **para**, **a fin de**, **con el fin de**, **con el objeto de**, **con vistas a**.

With **two subjects**, add **que** + **subjunctive**: **para que**, **a fin de que**, **con el fin de que**, **con el objeto de que**.

The tense follows the main verb: lo **hago** para que **estés** contento; lo **hice** para que **estuvieras** contento.

After a verb of movement (ir, venir, salir, subir, bajar) Spanish uses **a**: vengo **a** verte; vengo **a que** me **expliques** esto.

After a command, a bare **que** can express purpose: acércate, **que** te **vea**.

**No sea que** + subjunctive is in case something unwanted happens: llévate el paraguas, **no sea que llueva**.

**¿Para qué?** asks for the purpose. **¿Por qué?** asks for the cause.

filas: con el objeto de que + subjunctive

titulo.en: A notice from the town hall

frases.es: El ayuntamiento ha tomado varias medidas a fin de mejorar el tráfico.
frases.en: The town hall has taken several measures in order to improve the traffic.

frases.es: Se cerrará el centro a los coches para que los vecinos puedan pasear.
frases.en: The centre will be closed to cars so that residents can walk around.

frases.es: Habrá más autobuses con el objeto de que nadie necesite el coche.
frases.en: There will be more buses with the aim that nobody needs a car.

frases.es: Los técnicos irán a los barrios a que los vecinos les cuenten sus problemas.
frases.en: Technicians will go to the neighbourhoods so that residents can tell them their problems.

frases.es: Salgan con tiempo, no sea que encuentren calles cortadas.
frases.en: Leave in good time, in case you find streets closed.

pregunta.en: Complete: I did it so that you would be happy.

estuvieras.en: A past main verb takes the past subjunctive.

estés.en: Estés follows a main verb in the present.

estabas.en: Para que always takes the subjunctive.

pregunta.en: Complete, one subject: they took measures in order to improve the traffic.

bloques.frase: Tomaron medidas a fin de ___ el tráfico.

mejoraran.en: Without que you need the infinitive.

pregunta.en: Complete: I've come so that you can explain this to me.

a que.en: After a verb of movement: a que.

bloques.frase: Llévate el paraguas, no sea que llueva.

texto.en: Take the umbrella, in case it rains.
Take the umbrella, since it isn't raining.

explicacion.en: No sea que warns of something that may happen.

texto.en: Don't take the umbrella unless it rains.

pregunta.en: What is the difference between «¿por qué?» and «¿para qué?»

They mean the same.en: Por looks back at the cause, para forward at the aim.

bloques.correcta: The first asks for the cause, the second for the purpose

bloques.frase: Se cerrará el centro para que los vecinos puedan pasear

traduccion.en: The centre will be closed so that residents can walk around.

texto.en:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (150–180 words).** Write a formal proposal to your town council asking for an improvement in your neighbourhood, explaining its purposes.

**Speak (about 3 minutes).** Present aloud a project at work and explain what each measure is for.
